full_judgment: 5. Thereafter the plaintiff-petitioners and the defendant Nos. 1-3 (opposite party Nos. 2-4 in this Rule) filed a solenama along with a fresh power on 13.11.11 in T.S. No. 583 of 1981 in the Court of Munsif, Gazipur and 30-11-81 was the date given for recording the compromise. On 30.11.81 the date was shifted to 3.11.81. On all these days the added defendant No.4 (the opposite party No.1 in this Rule) did not enter appearance. The suit was decreed on compromise between the plaintiff-petitioners on the one hand and the defendants 1-3 (opposite party Nos. 2-4 in this Rule) on the other by the Order of the learned Munsif, Gazipur dated 3.12.81.
